CapStatus.description: Outcome of the growth cap check (SPEC-0006 R8).

oneOf.description: The growth is at or below the cap.
The growth is above the cap: reported, not refused.

method.description: Method id of the technique, for example `tv.gordon`.

method_version.description: Version of the technique's method that produced this row.

output.description: The technique's own output, with its implied assumptions.

terminal_value.description: Terminal value at N, not discounted, in currency units.

growth_cap.description: Implied growth compared with the cap; `null` when no cap is given.

implied_growth.description:
Perpetual growth implied by the multiple, r − CF_{N+1} / TV_N, decimal fraction per
period; `null` when `rate` and `next_flow` are not given.

terminal_value.description: Terminal value at N, not discounted, in currency units.

FlowBasis.description: How the flow at N + 1 was obtained.

growth_cap.description: Growth compared with the cap; `null` when no cap is given.

next_flow.description: Flow at N + 1 used, in currency units.

terminal_value.description: Terminal value at N, not discounted, in currency units.

GrowthCapCheck.description: The perpetual growth compared with the cap the analyst gave.

cap.description: The cap given, decimal fraction per period.

growth.description: The perpetual growth checked, decimal fraction per period.

extra_growth_value.description:
Value of the growth above g_l during the decline, CF_N × H × (g_s − g_l) / (r − g_l),
in currency units.

growth_cap.description: Long-term growth compared with the cap; `null` when no cap is given.

stable_growth_value.description: Value at stable growth, CF_N × (1 + g_l) / (r − g_l), in currency units.

terminal_value.description: Terminal value at N, not discounted, in currency units.

annuity_factor.description: Value at N of a first flow of 1 (the annuity factor shared with `tvm.annuity`).

discount_factor.description: (1 + r)^−n, the factor that brings the residual value from N + n to N.

flows_value.description: Value at N of the flows of periods N + 1 to N + n, in currency units.

growth_cap.description: Growth compared with the cap; `null` when no cap is given.

residual_value_discounted.description: Residual value brought to N, in currency units.

terminal_value.description:
Terminal value at N, not discounted to the valuation date, in currency units: the value
of the n flows plus the discounted residual value.

tax_on_gains.description: Tax on gains, in currency units, as given.

terminal_value.description:
Net liquidation value at N, not discounted, in currency units; negative when the
liabilities and costs exceed the realisable values.

total_assets.description: Sum of the realisable values of the assets, in currency units.

total_liabilities.description: Sum of the liabilities, in currency units.

total_liquidation_costs.description: Sum of the liquidation costs, in currency units.

growth_cap.description: Growth compared with the cap (0 when no growth is given); `null` when no cap is given.

terminal_value.description: Terminal value at N, not discounted, in currency units.

TechniqueOutput.description: The full output of one technique, as its own method returns it.

TerminalBasis.description: Whether a terminal value is a value of the whole business or of its equity.

oneOf.description:
Enterprise value: flows to all capital providers (FCFF), discounted at the WACC;
multiples EV/EBITDA, EV/EBIT, EV/Sales.

Equity value: flows to shareholders (FCFE, dividends), discounted at the cost of
equity; multiple P/E.

growth_cap.description: Growth compared with the cap; `null` when no cap is given.

next_free_cash_flow.description: Free cash flow at N + 1, NOPAT_{N+1} × (1 − g / RONIC), in currency units.

reinvestment_rate.description: Share of NOPAT reinvested to earn the growth, g / RONIC, decimal fraction.

terminal_value.description: Terminal value at N, not discounted, in currency units.

value_of_growth.description: `creates`, `none` or `destroys`: RONIC above, equal to or below the rate.

ValueOfGrowth.description: Whether growth adds value, from the return on new capital against the rate.

oneOf.description: RONIC above the rate: growth creates value.
RONIC equal to the rate: growth creates no value; TV = NOPAT_{N+1} / r for any g.
RONIC below the rate: growth destroys value.

basis.description: The basis of every terminal value in `results`.

results.description: One row per technique, in the order requested.
